original_value: The Patriot Burst Solid-State Drive (SSD) is the perfect way to enhance computer performance. Burst offers transfer speeds at up to 555 MB/s read and 500 MB/s write speeds to eliminate bottlenecks. A SATA III 6 GB/s Interface that is backwards compatible with SATA II 3 GB/s, this SSD provides greater performance over traditional HDDs.
